title: Rules for New Workers
text: Welcome to your new job. Please read these rules. You have to arrive on time; the office opens at eight o'clock. You mustn't be late for a meeting with a customer. You have to wear the uniform, but you don't have to wear it on Friday. You should ask your boss if you have a problem. You mustn't use your phone during a meeting. You have to finish your work before the deadline. You should take a break for thirty minutes at one o'clock. If you are sick, you must call the office early. Good luck!
